name: Are heat pump systems standard in green homes?

mainEntity.name: Are heat pump systems standard in green homes?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, air-source or ground-source heat pumps provide efficient heating, cooling, and hot water, often replacing fossil fuel furnaces to cut emissions by 50-70%.
